title: Canonical cokernel augmentation in the homotopy category
statement: For the explicit enlarged bar tower [def-sc-compact-flat-enlarged-bar-tower] and its augmentations q_n, for every proof hz of delta;desc(q)=0, the canonical cokernel.desc map into the telescope is invertible in the homotopy category [def-sc-flat-telescope-stage-map].

source.place: The source-bar, finite-cone-block, least-block adjunction and union-bar paragraphs; Canonical cokernel augmentation in the homotopy category.

proof.text: Under unionIso the cokernel.desc map is the composite of the canonical cokernel-to-full-bar isomorphism and the full-bar augmentation. The quotient functor preserves the first isomorphism; the second is invertible by fullBarAugmentation_isIso. Their composite is invertible.

proof_origin.place: Explicit Lean construction and proof, expanding the corresponding paragraph of the parent argument.

lemma cokernelAugmentation_isIso
    (hz : flatTelescopeDifferential (enlargedBar D E t p hp)
      (enlargedBarMap D E t p hp) ≫
        Sigma.desc (enlargedBarAugmentation D E t p hp) = 0) :
    IsIso ((HomotopyCategory.quotient _ (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).map
      (cokernel.desc (flatTelescopeDifferential (enlargedBar D E t p hp)
        (enlargedBarMap D E t p hp))
          (Sigma.desc (enlargedBarAugmentation D E t p hp)) hz))
